labels.name: Subclavian artery
labels.function: Becomes the next segment at the lateral border of the 1st rib

labels.name: Thyrocervical trunk
labels.function: Neck branch whose suprascapular artery joins the scapular network

labels.name: Axillary artery
labels.function: Divided into three parts by pectoralis minor

labels.name: Subscapular artery
labels.function: Largest part-3 branch; gives the circumflex scapular artery

labels.name: Posterior circumflex humeral artery
labels.function: Encircles the surgical neck via the quadrangular space

labels.name: Brachial artery
labels.function: Begins at teres major; main supply of the arm

labels.name: Deep brachial artery
labels.function: Largest arm branch; supplies the posterior compartment

labels.name: Radial artery
labels.function: Lateral forearm artery; most commonly checked wrist pulse

labels.name: Ulnar artery
labels.function: Medial forearm artery; pulse at the medial wrist

labels.name: Common interosseous artery
labels.function: Splits into anterior and posterior branches for the deep forearm

labels.name: Deep palmar arch
labels.function: Hand arch fed mainly by the lateral forearm artery

labels.name: Superficial palmar arch
labels.function: Hand arch fed mainly by the medial forearm artery

labels.name: Internal jugular vein
labels.function: Neck vein that meets the limb's main vein near the clavicle

labels.name: Brachiocephalic vein
labels.function: Right and left unite to form the superior vena cava

labels.name: Subclavian vein
labels.function: Continues the limb vein from the lateral border of the 1st rib

labels.name: Right lymphatic duct
labels.function: Returns lymph of the right upper limb to the bloodstream

labels.name: Axillary vein
labels.function: Formed at teres major; receives the deltopectoral vein

labels.name: Axillary lymph nodes
labels.function: Main limb drainage center; removal causes lymphedema

labels.name: Brachial veins
labels.function: Paired deep veins formed by the radial and ulnar veins

labels.name: Cephalic vein
labels.function: Lateral superficial vein ascending to the deltopectoral groove

labels.name: Basilic vein
labels.function: Medial superficial vein that joins the paired deep veins

labels.name: Median cubital vein
labels.function: Common venipuncture site at the front of the elbow

labels.name: Cubital lymph nodes
labels.function: First nodes near the elbow for hand and forearm lymph
